Financially evaluated bidders (at least L-1 to L-3) shall submit original copies of all uploaded documents within seven (07) working days from opening of the f inancial bid or as directed by the procuring entity which is earlier. Failing may r esult in forfeiture of EMD, blacklisting and other legal action, only after due proc ess and show cause notice. 8. Original documents shall be identical to the uploaded scanned copies. Any di screpancy, mismatch, alteration, tampering, forged document or false informati on shall render the bid liable for rejection and may result in forfeiture of EMD, bl acklisting and other legal action, only after due process and show cause notice. 9. The bidder shall submit a notarized affidavit on Rs.10/- stamp paper declarin g that neither the bidder nor its firm has been blacklisted/debarred by any Gove rnment Department, PSU, Government Undertaking or Urban Local Body during the last three years. 10. OEM shall submit a separate notarized affidavit on Rs.10/- stamp paper decl aring that it has not been blacklisted/debarred by any Government Department, PSU, Government Undertaking or Urban Local Body during the last three years. 11. Any false, manipulated or misleading declaration submitted by the bidder or OEM shall result in rejection of the bid and suitable legal action.

12.The bidder shall submit a notarized declaration on Rs.100/- stamp paper disclosing whether any near relative or blood relative of the proprietor, partner, director or authorized signatory of the bidding entity is presently employed in N agar Palika Parishad Chhibramau, Kannauj. In case such relationship exists, the bidder shall clearly specify the name, designation, nature of relationship and pla ce of posting of the concern ed employee. Suppression, concealment or misrepr esentation of such information shall render the bid liabl e for rejection and may invite appropriate action as deemed fit by the procuring entity. 13. Partnership firms shall submit a copy of the registered partnership deed. 14. PAN, GST Registration Certificate and Identity/Address Proof of proprietor, p artners or directors shall be submitted. 15. The bidder shall have a positive net worth and shall submit a Net Worth Cer tificate issued by a Charter ed Accountant along with UDIN. C. OEM APPROVAL, AUTHORIZATION & LEGAL ELIGIBILITY. 16. The offered LED Street Light Model shall be approved under UPPWD AAA C ategory and Pole approved UPPWD OEM shall submit: a. Valid UPPWD approval Certificate. b. Approval annexures. c. List of approved models. 17. The bidder shall submit a valid OEM authorization certificate specifically me ntioning the bid number and bid opening date. 18. OEM shall submit a valid Make in India Certificate confirming minimum loca l content of 50%. D. EXPERIENCE & PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS 19. OEM shall submit at least one satisfactory performance/ completion certific ate for supply of LED Flood lighting products to any Government Department. 20. The bidder shall have successfully completed supply & Fixing of same or si milar category products during the last Seven financial years and satisfy any on e of the following: a. One order equal to at least 80% of tender quantity; or b. Two ordrs each equal to at least 60% of tender quantity; or c. Three orders each equal to at least 40% of tender quantity. 21. Documentary evidence in the form of completion certificates, CRAC certific ates or equivalent certificates issued by Government Departments shall be sub mitted. 22. OEM shall submit documentary evidence/job sheets of successful replacem ent of defective LED Flood lights or components in Government Departments du ring the last three years. E. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS & QUALITY REQUIREMENTS 23. Offered LED street Lights shall conform to IP-66 standards and valid NABL-a

ccredited test reports sha ll be submitted. 24. LED street Lights and drivers shall possess valid BIS certification. 25. LM-79 test report from a NABL-accredited laboratory shall be submitted. 26. UPPWD-approved model number shall be permanently engraved/embossed on the product body. F. WARRANTY, AFTER-SALES SERVICE & REPLACEM ENT OBLIGATIONS 27. OEM shall provide a comprehensive five-year replacement warranty on its l etterhead mentioning bid number and date. 28. OEM shall provide a dedicated email address and/or toll-free number for co mplaint registration. 29. OEM shall submit a notarized declaration confirming that all complaints shal l be attended within three working days from receipt of complaint. 30. OEM shall deposit advance stock of replacement drivers equal to 2% of sup plied quantity in the buyer's store. 31. Whenever defective drivers are replaced, the OEM shall replenish the advan ce stock with equivalent fresh drivers throughout the warranty period. 32. OEM shall submit an undertaking agreeing to comply with the advance-driv er replacement mechanism throughout the warranty period. 33. Failure to comply with warranty obligations may result in blacklisting, forfei ture of security deposit, recovery of losses and any other action deemed approp riate by the procuring entity. G. INSPECTION, TESTING & GENUINENESS VERIFICATION 34. After supply, an authorized representative of the OEM shall visit the purcha ser's store and verify that t he supplied products are genuine OEM products. 35. The OEM representative shall submit: a. Product Genuineness Certificate. b. Warranty Certificate. c. Product Model Number and Batch Number details. 36. The procuring entity reserves the right to get the offered products tested fr om any NABL-accredited la boratory. If the product fails to meet specified para meters, the bid/contract shall be liable for cancellation and appropriate action may be taken against the OEM. 37. All expenses, fees, testing charges and statutory compliances required for obtaining such approval/NOC/certificate shall be borne by the contractor and sh all be deemed included in the quoted rates.

H. PAYMENT TERMS. 38. Payment shall be released only after satisfactory supply, installation, testin g and commissioning and successful verification of quantity, quality and specifications by the authorized representative/ committee o f the procuring ent ity. 39. The procuring entity shall have the right to conduct inspection, testing and quality checks before processing payment. 40. In case of any deficiency, defect, short supply, quality issue or deviation fro m specifications, payment may be withheld wholly or partly until satisfactory re ctification. 41. All payments shall be made subject to availability of funds and in accordanc e with Government Orders , Financial Rules, Treasury Rules and applicable proc urement guidelines. 42. No interest, compensation, damages, escalation or any other claim whatsoe ver shall be payable by th e procuring entity on account of delay in release of p ayment for any reason. I. REFUND OF EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT (EMD) 43. EMD of unsuccessful bidders shall be refunded only after completion of fina ncial evaluation and verification of original bid documents wherever required. 44. 45. 46. No EMD refund shall be processed until the required bank verification certif icate and original documents (where demanded) are verified by the procuring e ntity. 47.Any delay arising due to incorrect, incomplete or unverified bank details shal l be the sole responsibility of the bidder.

48. No claim for interest, compensation or damages on account of delayed EM D refund shall be entertain ed by the procuring entity. J. ELECTRICAL SAFTY LICENCE 49. The bidder shall possess a valid Electrical Safety Licence/Electrical Contract or Licence issued by the competent authority under applicable laws and regulations. A self-attested copy of the valid licence shall be submitted along with the technical bid. Bids submitted without a valid Electrical Safety Licence s hall be liable for rejection. 50. The contractor shall be responsible for obtaining all necessary approvals, p ermissions, clearances and No Objection Certificates (NOCs), if required, from t he Electrical Safety Department or any other competent authority for energizati on and safe operation of the installed 7 MTR POLE LED Lighting system. 51. Before release of final payment, the contractor shall submit the Electrical S afety Department's approval/NOC/Energization Certificate, wherever applicable under law. In the absence of such approval/NOC/certificate, the procuring entity shall have the right to withhold payment until compliance is ensured. .
